g.text: Management fees fund operationsand carry rewards profits
Support the team and operating costs
The fee base agreed in the LPA
Profits determined under the distribution waterfall
Paid when the agreed distribution conditions are met
Any preferred return, catch-up and other provisions depend on the LPA

Source: Metrick & Yasuda, The Economics of Private Equity Funds, working paper, 1 Jul 2007, pp. 8–12. The actual fee base and waterfall follow theLPA; the illustration does not confirm TPG VI's specific terms.
